I added a project registry for professors: title, year, financing type (Público or Privado), financier and total value. I couldn't run it, because `bin/rails` fails to load in this environment. I only checked `Project` with `ruby -c`, which passed. The migration hasn't been run, and `db/schema.rb` was edited by hand.

- **Model:** `Project` belongs to a professor and requires all five fields. Year must be a positive integer and total value must be zero or more. The financing type is limited to `Público` and `Privado`.
- **Database:** a `projects` table, added in `db/migrate/20241101000000_create_projects.rb` and mirrored in `db/schema.rb`.
- **Screens:** a new `ProjectsController`, helper, route and pt-BR locale file. The professor is picked with the record-select widget and the financing type with a dropdown.
- **Professor link:** `Professor` has many projects. Deleting a professor who has projects is blocked, as it is for advisements and scholarships. Projects also show on the professor's detail page.
- **Permissions:** `Project` is in `PROFESSOR_MODELS`, so administrators, coordination and secretariat can manage it. Professors can read it but not create or edit.

The issue says each professor registers their own projects. I didn't build a restriction that lets a professor edit only their own projects. That needs a decision on how a professor user is tied to their record.

I picked the names `Project`, `title`, `financing_type`, `financier` and `total_value` myself, since the issue doesn't specify them. I added no specs or factory for the new model.
